root_cause.text: In ksmbd, the `conn->binding` flag used to gate the slowpath session lookup in `ksmbd_session_lookup_all()` is not properly scoped to bound sessions, allowing a connection to retrieve any session by ID via the slowpath even if the connection is not a channel of that session, leading to potential unauthorized access or manipulation.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (sess && !xa_load(&sess->ksmbd_chann_list, (long)conn))` after the slowpath lookup to enforce that the session must have the connection registered in its channel xarray. The commit message explains: "When the binding SESSION_SETUP sets conn->binding = true, the flag stays set after the call so that the global session lookup in ksmbd_session_lookup_all() can find the session, which was not added to conn->sessions. Because the flag is connection-wide, the global lookup path will also resolve any other session by id if asked."
